title: Consultant | Mainframe | Pune | Engineering | Platform Development & Integration
description:
**Consultant | Mainframe | Pune | Engineering | Platform Development & Integration**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 115844
  
• **Location**: Pune
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.

  

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled Mainframe Application Support Engineer to join our Development & Application Maintenance and Support (AMS) team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the stability, performance, and integrity of our mission-critical mainframe applications. You will handle incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and minor enhancements within a complex environment powered by COBOL, DB2, and CICS.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Application Support & Incident Management:

* Provide Level 2/Level 3 support for production mainframe applications.
* Perform rapid troubleshooting and incident resolution for batch failures and online transaction errors.
* Manage "on-call" rotations to ensure 24/7 availability for critical business processes.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring issues to prevent future outages.

2. Maintenance & Minor Enhancements:

* Analyze, design, and implement code changes (bug fixes and small enhancements) in COBOL.
* Modify and optimize DB2 stored procedures, triggers, and complex SQL queries.
* Update and maintain CICS online screens and transaction logic to meet evolving business requirements.
* Perform impact analysis for any code changes to ensure zero disruption to downstream systems.

3. Batch & Online Operations:

* Monitor and manage batch job flows using scheduling tools (e.g., CA7, Control-M, or OPC/TWS).
* Troubleshoot JCL (Job Control Language) errors, including S0C4, S0C7, and B37 abends.
* Manage CICS transaction environments, ensuring online availability and monitoring task performance.

4. Database & Data Integrity:

* Perform DB2 data corrections and data cleansing via SQL or utility programs.
* Monitor DB2 performance, including table space utilization and index efficiency.
Work closely with Database Administrators (DBAs) to resolve locking or contention issues.  

**Required Technical Skills**

* Programming Languages: Expert-level COBOL (Enterprise COBOL).
* Database: Advanced DB2 (SQL, Bind/Plan, troubleshooting complex joins, and performance tuning).
* Online Environment: Hands-on experience with CICS (Transaction monitoring, Screen handling, and CICS commands).
* JCL & Utilities: Proficiency in JCL and standard IBM utilities (SORT, ICETOOL, IDCAMS, etc.).
* Tools: Experience with Mainframe Debuggers (e.g., IBM Debug Tool, XPEDITER) and File Management tools (e.g., File-AID, File Manager).
Version Control: Experience with Endevor, Changeman, or similar SCM (Software Configuration Management) tools.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Years of Experience: 4+ years of experience in Mainframe application support.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience in [Insert Industry, e.g., Banking, Insurance, or Retail] is highly desirable.
* Modernization Interest: Understanding of how Mainframe systems interface with Cloud/Distributed environments (e.g., via MQ Series or APIs) is a plus.
Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, ability to work under pressure during production outages, and excellent communication skills for documenting technical resolutions.  

**Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Hybrid Work Model)
description:
**Lead AI Platform Engineer**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Model of Work: Hybrid**

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

**Job Purpose**

We're hiring a Lead AI Platform Engineer: a lead, hands-on engineer who will champion our AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across engineering teams and design and build core parts of our AI platform, working day to day with our Pune and US AI platform team.

The team owns the Agentic AI Platform and drives AI adoption, including AIDLC, across the engineering departments. We don't hand work off after release: the team builds it, ships it, monitors it, and supports it in production.

This is an individual contributor role, not a team lead or people-management position. You lead through technical depth: owning hard problems, setting a high bar for quality, and helping the engineers around you do their best work.

**What You Will Own:**

You will own technical design and delivery for your areas of the AI platform, and help drive AIDLC adoption across engineering.

* **The Agentic AI Platform:** the agentic runtime and LLM gateway.
* **Shared platform services**: a growing set of services, such as a knowledge base built on a vector database.
* **AIDLC and AI adoption:** helping engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.

**Responsibilities:**

**AIDLC and AI adoption**

* Make AI-assisted engineering the norm by championing AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.
* Help engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC in their own workflows and codebases.

**Technical design**

* Take on the most complex platform work across the AI platform, Databricks, and shared services.
* Make design and trade-off decisions for your areas.
* Contribute to technical planning with the Pune and US teams.

**Hands-on engineering**

* Spend time writing, testing, and shipping code across Python, TypeScript, C#, and Elixir codebases.

**Engineering quality**

* Set a high bar for testing, code review, design documentation, and observability through your own work and reviews.
* Work closely with QA and DevOps so quality is built in, not inspected in.

**Production ownership**

* Make sure what you ship is deployed safely, monitored, and supported in production.
* Help lead the response when something breaks.

**Cross-site collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with the OPTI US team by sharing designs, aligning priorities, and keeping work moving across time zones.

* **And other duties as assigned.**

**Requirements:**

We care about lead-level capability, not a title. Manager experience is not required if you've been the person others go to for technical direction.

* Lead-level software engineering experience building and running production systems, typically 10+ years.
* Production experience in at least two of Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#, and the comfort to pick up the rest.
* A strong testing mindset: you design for testability and treat automated tests as part of the work.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and engineering automation, and a view on how they change the way teams build software.
* Experience working with AIDLC or a similar structured approach to AI-assisted delivery.
* Experience owning services in production, including deployments, monitoring, and incident response.
* Experience supporting other engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
* Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with distributed teams across India and the US.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience building with LLMs, such as agents, tool use, orchestration, or an LLM gateway.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, or large-scale data pipelines.
* Azure knowledge, including CI/CD.
* Experience onboarding new team members.
* Background in enterprise software.

**Our Stack:**

* Languages: Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#
* Cloud and data: Azure and Azure Databricks
* AI platform: an in-house agentic runtime and LLM gateway
* Engineering: AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

**Quorum Diversity Statement:** At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

*Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.*

**Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department**

**Recruitment Scam Alert:** Quorum Software does not charge fees, request payments, conduct interviews via messaging apps, or request the installation of software at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate recruitment activities are conducted exclusively through our official careers website (www.quorumsoftware.com/careers) and email addresses ending in **@quorumsoftware.com**. Any communication that does not originate from these official channels should be considered unauthorized and may be reported to careers@quorumsoftware.com

title: L1 NOC & Monitoring Engineer
description:
Job Purpose:

The L1 NOC & Monitoring Engineer serves as the first line of defense for monitoring enterprise network health, infrastructure alerts, and link statuses. Based out of our Pune: IT & NOC Operations Center, this role is responsible for initial alert triage, logging incident tickets, executing basic Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and escalating unresolved issues to L2/L3 teams or service providers within specified SLA timelines.

Key Responsibilities:

**Real-Time Monitoring & Alert Triage**

 Monitor Maintain and administer applications systems and related computing

environments including computer hardware, systems software, applications software,

and all related configurations.

 Monitor voice infrastructure health, trunk utilization, and voice traffic trends using

monitoring platforms issues within SLA targets.

 Actively monitor enterprise dashboards, routers, switches, firewalls, IT Infrastructure

and WAN/LAN links using enterprise network monitoring tools.

 Detect, validate, and categorize incoming automated system alerts (UP/DOWN status,

high CPU/memory utilization, interface errors, packet loss).

 Filter out false positives and create structured incident tickets for genuine network

**First-Level Support & Incident Handling**

 Perform basic L1 troubleshooting following standard runbooks and SOPs

 Execute preliminary ticket logging, impact assessment, and categorization on ITSM tools

 Contact Clients, site contacts or local administrators during branch outages to verify

power, cabling, and physical device statuses.

 Troubleshoots applications problems or systems failure involving infrastructure and

software to determine the causes (Root Cause Analysis) and possible solutions;

implements solutions to resolve problems.

 Support, Plan, coordinate, and implement security measures to protect data, software,

and hardware.

**Vendor & ISP Escalation**

 Log support tickets with local and national Internet Service Providers and global carriers

for circuit faults or link down events.

 Follow up regularly with service providers to obtain Estimated Time of Restoration (ETR)

and track updates to resolution.

 Escalate complex, non-SOP, or critical (P1/P2) incidents to L2 Network Engineers or

escalation leads promptly.

**Shift Handover & ; Daily Operations**

 Maintain clear incident logs and update ticket work notes with step-by-step

troubleshooting actions.

 Conduct structured shift handover meetings at the end of every shift to transition active

tickets and ongoing outages to incoming team members.

**The Work: Key Essentials**

 Ability to work on 24X7 Support model including shifts and on call duties.

 Install, configure, and maintain IP PBX hardware and software solutions.

 Configure SIP trunks, PRI lines, FXS/FXO gateways, SBCs (Session Border Controllers),

and VoIP phones/endpoints.

 Manage dial plans, IVR trees, hunt groups, call queues, call routing rules, and voicemail

systems.

 Handle user onboarding, extensions provisioning, softphone setup, and permission

management.

 Undertake special projects/tasks and other duties as assigned by the company.

 Significant experience working on Linux based infrastructure and OS.

 Knowledge of databases basic operations especially MySQL and MongoDB will be plus.

 Knowledge of best practices in IT operations, incident management and change

management.

 Performs server evaluation and optimization on a regular basis

 Surveys performance needs and goals of LAN/WAN users

 Internet/Intranet connectivity and continuity

 Manages all administrative aspects of corporate and customer desktop support

 Maintains documentation of the physical and logical network

 Maintains Corporate and Virtual Servers, including those located offsite

 Participates in departmental on-call rotation

 Provide remote support over chat, phone and email

 System administration tasks (user administration, back-ups, etc.)

 Other duties as may be assigned by management

**Required Qualifications & ; Experience**

**Education**: B.E. / B.Tech or 3-year Diploma in Electronics / Computer Engineering.

**Experience**: 3 to 4 years of relevant experience in IT monitoring, network desk, or

technical helpdesk environments.

**Certifications (Preferred):**

o Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) course completion or certification.

o Basic understanding of ITIL framework concepts (ITIL v4 Foundation is a plus).

o Additional certification in Microsoft, Fortinet, SonicWALL, VMware or is a plus.

**Technical Skills & Core Knowledge**

* Networking Basics: Clear conceptual understanding of OSI model layers, TCP/IP protocol suite, IP addressing, Subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and ping/traceroute utilities.
* Monitoring & Ticketing Tools: Basic operational familiarity with enterprise monitoring tools and ticketing software
* Device Knowledge: Elementary understanding of network hardware (routers, switches,firewalls, wireless access points).
* Knowledge of best practices in IT operations, incident management and change management.
* Maintenance and enhancement of technical knowledge
* Proven Work Experience as a Technical Support Engineer,
* Desktop Support IT Help Desk Technician or similar role
* Hands-on experience with Windows Server + Linux OS environments
* Hands-on experience with working on Firewalls VPN Configuration
* Hands-on with working on VM Environments
* Good understanding of systems, mobile devices and other tech products
* Ability to diagnose and basic issues
* Familiarity with remote applications and help desk software
* Significant managing web servers, servers, mail servers. name servers
* Primary experience with Microsoft 2003 / 2008 greatly preferred
* Significant experience with IIS alternatively Apache; key protocols (ftp, smtp; RDP, http;https; TCP/IP etc.); remote hard administration (stats; backup; real-time monitoring);cron jobs; mime types (varied); DNS Experience with server performance issues including load splitting/balancing, performance tuning, SCSI/RAID/SATA, and network connectivity.
* Knowledge of security issues, web administration, parallel and mirror sites; user per missioning schemes all in a Microsoft server environment preferred.
* Familiarity with database administration MSSQ / MySQL is Plus
* **Work Conditions & Personal Attributes**

** Shift Operations:** Mandatory willingness to work in 24/7 rotational shift schedules

Work Conditions & Personal Attributes

** Shift Operations:** Mandatory willingness to work in 24/7 rotational shift schedules

(including night shifts, weekends, and national holidays).

** Communication Skills:** Strong written and verbal English communication skills for

professional email updates, phone escalations, and internal team logging.

 Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service

 Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

 Ability to provide step- by-step help, both written and verbal

 Process-oriented with great documentation skills

 Process Discipline: High attention to detail with strict adherence to escalation paths,

SOP execution, and ticket SLA deadlines.

**What We Offer (India Market Compensation & Perks)**

**Compensation Structure:** Competitive Fixed Salary + Night Shift Allowance + Other

Allowances as applicable

**Career Growth:** Structured internal career progression paths toward L2 Network

Engineering/Shift Leader.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: SQL Server Database Architect
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced SQL Server Database Architect to lead the architecture, governance, modernization, and operational excellence of enterprise SQL Server platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, database security, and operational resilience.

  

* **Role: SQL Server Database Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 12 to 17 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architecture for SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and decision frameworks for SQL Server platforms.
* Establish standards for clustering, Always On Availability Groups, backup, recovery, monitoring, encryption, and privileged access management.
* Develop lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernization, consolidation, and database migration roadmaps.
* Act as the technical design authority for enterprise database solutions.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, resilience, data governance, and service management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform modernization initiatives.
* Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions aligned to business requirements.
* Lead recovery planning, failover testing, restore validation, and resilience assessments.
* Define standards for indexing strategies, query optimization, workload management, and database performance tuning.
* Establish performance baselines, capacity models, and forecasting processes.
* Lead technical response during critical incidents and major platform outages.
* Drive root-cause analysis and implement long-term engineering improvements.
* Define database security architectures and governance standards.
* Implement controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, patching, hardening, secrets management, and service accounts.
* Partner with cybersecurity, audit, risk, and compliance teams to address control requirements and audit findings.
* Ensure database platforms comply with relevant regulatory and operational resilience requirements.
* Support data protection, retention, governance, and compliance initiatives across the organization.
* Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to database administrators and engineering teams.
* Review and approve complex implementation plans and solution designs.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools.
* Evaluate database technologies, vendor solutions, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to manage technical dependencies.
* Maintain architecture repositories, service maps, support models, standards, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to strategic technology planning and database platform governance.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 12-17 years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Architecture roles.

title: Sr Oracle Database Administration
description:
**Req ID:** 388063
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Sr Oracle Database Administration to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
Sr Oracle Database Administration
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking a highly skilled Oracle Database Administrator to support enterprise database environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
Acts as a key resource responsible for administration, maintenance, and optimization of Oracle database environments supporting enterprise applications. Ensures high availability, performance, and security while delivering services aligned to ITIL processes, SLAs, and operational standards. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and compliance of database systems across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The position supports mission-critical environments support both on-premises and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments, including RAC, Data Guard, ASM, Exadata and modernization initiatives. This role contributes to proactive monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous improvement in database services.
  
  
Primary Responsibilities
  
  
A. Database Administration Lifecycle Management
  

* Manage full database lifecycle including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning
* Perform database provisioning, schema management, and storage optimization
* Execute database migrations, upgrades, and platform modernization initiatives

B. High Availability Disaster Recovery
  

* Implement and manage Oracle RAC, Data Guard, and ASM environments
* Design and support disaster recovery strategies and failover mechanisms
* Ensure business continuity through resilient architecture and validation testing

C. Performance Tuning Optimization
  

* Monitor database performance and conduct query optimization, indexing, and partitioning strategies
* Perform capacity planning and performance trend analysis
* Leverage OEM and OCI observability tools for proactive monitoring

D. Backup, Recovery Data Protection
  

* Define and execute backup strategies using RMAN and enterprise tools
* Perform database recovery, restore, and disaster recovery drills
* Ensure data integrity and compliance with recovery SLAs

E. Security Compliance
  

* Implement database security controls including encryption, access control, and auditing
* Manage Oracle Security, Oracle Key Vault (OKV), and compliance requirements (SOX, HIPAA, etc.)
* Apply patches and security hardening practices aligned with policies

F. Cloud Platform Modernization
  

* Administer Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments
* Support cloud migration, hybrid architecture, and database transformation initiatives
* Implement OCI services including monitoring, logging, and automation frameworks

G. Incident, Problem Change Management
  

* Troubleshoot and resolve database incidents and performance issues
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures
* Participate in CAB processes and change management workflows

H. Stakeholder Project Management
  

* Collaborate with application teams, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders
* Lead or support database-related projects and initiatives
* Provide status reporting, documentation, and knowledge transfer
* Oracle Database Administration (Core DBA)
* Oracle Exadata Administration
* Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard
* Oracle Key Vault (OKV) Security Administration
* PL/SQL, SQL tuning performance optimization
* Backup Recovery (RMAN)
* Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM)
* Oracle APEX Development

Secondary / Preferred Skills
  

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Automation tools knowledge (Ansible, AWX) would be plus
* Replication tools (GoldenGate)

Experience Requirements
  

* Years of Experience: 12+ years
* Experience supporting enterprise, high-availability database environments
* Experience with cloud migrations and modernization initiatives preferred

Education Certifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / IT or equivalent experience
* Oracle certifications (DBA / OCI / Security) – Preferred

Soft Skills Competencies
  

* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Ability to manage critical production environments
* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work in fast-paced, SLA-driven environments
* Team collaboration and mentoring capabilities

title: Technical Expert, Services Subscription (Hybrid Work Model)
description:
**Expert**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Mode of Work: Hybrid**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international, and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Overview**

As a member of the Upgrades Center of Excellence (COE), the Integration Expert is a strong technical role in our Professional Services team and will help implement innovative software solutions for energy companies across North America and around the world. The Integration Expert will be responsible for planning, designing, deploying, and innovating on technical services for customers as part of implementing proprietary software solutions to best fit customer needs. They will develop mastery & facilitate improvements of Quorum application installations and upgrades, infrastructure management, and enterprise software environment maintenance. The individual should have a strong desire for continuous learning and growth of technical skills, with the aspiration to leverage these skills to provide a positive experience for internal and external customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee end-to-end application installations, upgrades, and other technical services for enterprise software customers, often with complex and highly customized solutions
* Lead technical teams and initiatives focused on configuration, development, deployment, integration, testing and support of Quorum’s business software applications using industry standards, best practices, and tools
* Master and train others on technical skills required for successful delivery, such as SQL, API configuration, Azure DevOps Pipelines, C# troubleshooting, and in-house Quorum tools
* Take a leadership role in the design, configuration/development, and testing phases of software implementation, upgrade, and enhancement projects
* Serve as the primary Quorum representative for customers in order to gather business and technical specifications, install software updates, train IT personnel, and resolve issues
* Manage multiple ongoing customer commitments and balance priorities across projects on independent schedules, working toward successful completion of project-level goals
* Demonstrate technical and product expertise in customer conversations while representing Quorum positively
* Mentor junior team members towards mastery of technical skills and ownership of high-quality, timely work
* Plan and execute improvements to software implementation and configuration tools, processes, and documentation
* Develop a deep understanding of Quorum’s architecture systems, integration platform capabilities, and software development lifecycle processes
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, business, or related discipline that has an analytical component
* 5+ years of related experience in software development, cloud operations, and/or business consulting

* Experience working with customers and software users to gather business and technical requirements and deploy efficient, high-quality solutions
* Experience leading a team (3-5 people), mentoring junior colleagues, and managing end-to-end work deliverables
* Strong database skills (SQL) such as writing functions/procedures, converting and managing large sets of data, configuring application features, and troubleshooting issues
* Strong programming skills (C# and/or other computer programming languages)
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and/or systems architecture
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills, desire for continuous learning
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with Cloud-based solutions, Cloud/SaaS project delivery model, DevOps deployments, and/or infrastructure management
* Demonstrated technical prowess including solving complex problems, programming skills (SQL, Git, C++/C#, Java, VB and/or other computer programming languages), and familiarity/understanding of systems architecture
* Demonstrated team leadership skills such as managing project schedules and fostering team collaboration
* Aspiration or work experience in the oil and gas industry
* Experience in management of software development efforts
* Interest to help grow and develop customer relationships through direct and meaningful interaction

* Willing to travel *occasionally* during the week to customer site (most work with customers is performed remotely from Quorum office or from home)

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

  

***Please Submit your CV/Resumé in*** ***English***

**About Quorum Software**
  
Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com.

**Quorum Diversity Statement**:At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

*Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.*

**Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department**

title: Database & Migration Engineer
description:
Role summary

You own the data. You build the SQL Server environment in Azure, move the production database with log shipping and reconciliation, and prepare the application servers for the application vendor's install. Your work is the critical path on cutover night.

Key responsibilities

* Build and tune SQL Server on Azure VMs per the capacity plan
* Plan and run the data migration: initial seed, log shipping, validation and reconciliation
* Run the migration rehearsal and prepare the rollback path
* Prepare application servers in the private subnet and support the application vendor's install and validation
* Carry out the database and application steps on the cutover night
* Run database restore checks as part of backup testing
* Contribute to testing, hypercare and knowledge transfer

Deliverables you own

Configured SQL Server environment · data migration plan · data reconciliation report · application installation and validation record

Must-have

* 5+ years as a SQL Server DBA, including 3+ years on migrations to Azure or other cloud
* Hands-on with log shipping, backup/restore, and large-database seeding (including bandwidth-limited links)
* SQL Server performance tuning, storage layout on Azure VMs, and HA/DR concepts
* Rigorous data validation and reconciliation habits (row counts, checksums, application-level checks)
* Comfort working alongside a software vendor's installers without owning their application
* PowerShell or T-SQL automation skills

Good to have

* Experience with healthcare databases (HIS, RIS/PACS) and patient-data sensitivity
* Azure Database Migration tooling, Always On Availability Groups
* Experience with cutover planning for 24x7 clinical systems

What independence looks like

You can own the migration plan from seed to final sync, run the rehearsal, and tell the team with evidence whether the data is ready for go-live.

Send your CV with two or three examples of Azure migration or equivalent projects you delivered independently, what you personally owned, and your notice period. Shortlisted candidates will have a technical interview followed by a short scenario exercise relevant to the role.

**Location:** Remote (some availability overlap with GST, UTC+3) · **Onsite visits:** only if the client requires, with travel arranged by the client side

Pay: From ₹371,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pune, Maharashtra

title: Consultant (Technical) - Hybrid Work Model
description:
**Consultant (Technical)**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Model of Work: Hybrid**

  

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

**Job Purpose**

The Consultant (Technical) is an experienced team member of the Professional Services (PS) business unit. They are responsible for planning and overseeing technical team activities to develop complex technical upgrades of customer solutions as well as install and deploy to customer environments. This role will require the individual to become an expert in Quorum’s enterprise software architecture and deployment processes, including maintenance of heavily customized code, databases, and installations, and to mentor other team members in these areas.

**What You Will Do:**

* Execute end-to-end technical upgrades to latest software versions across dozens of enterprise customers, from incremental monthly patches to major upgrades of versions 5+ years out of date
* Perform complex technical tasks independently, including database upgrade packaging, custom database object remediation, analysis of code customizations, development of outdated custom features in latest code version, deployment of Azure DevOps pipelines, and on-premise environment installations
* Perform assigned work with quality, timely delivery, and documentation. This includes proactively collaborating with team members to overcome any technical challenges and roadblocks.
* Balance workload priorities across multiple concurrent upgrades and deliverables for various customers
* Demonstrate mastery and drive improvements for technical skills required for successful deployments & upgrades, such as: SQL, NuGet, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and in-house Quorum tools.

* Participate in stand-ups and retrospectives to identify technical and process issues, discuss improvement ideas, and share knowledge
* Serve as a Quorum Subject Matter Expert (SME) in client conversations while representing Quorum positively
* Serve as a technical SME in several areas of our products and architecture
* Understand, follow, and broadcast process changes among team members
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 2+ years of experience in software deployments or development,
* Strong programming skills (C++/C# or similar) including developing enhancements, performing code reviews, and resolving bugs
* Strong database skills (SQL) including writing complex functions/procedures, converting and managing large sets of data, and troubleshooting issues
* Demonstrated ownership of own commitments to high-quality software deliverables and customer experience
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal

**Preferred Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, technology, or other analytical discipline
* Development or deployment experience working in an Agile environment
* Experience with cloud solutions and complex integrations

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with TFS – In case developer needs to look at code previously developed in older versions
* Ability to debug and troubleshoot application bugs in Visual Studio
* Exposure to Oil & Gas domain

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

  

**Quorum Diversity Statement**:At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

*Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.*

**Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department**
